Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with cough and cold.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has had a 4–5 day history of runny nose.
Patient has experienced a dry cough for 4–5 days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 4-5 day hx runny nose, dry cough.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels hot but has not measured temperature.
Patient reports generalized aches and pains.
Patient initially had diarrhea which has now resolved.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Initially had diarrhea which has now resolved.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is taking 2–3 Lemsips per day which eases symptoms.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Taking 2-3 lemsips a day which eases sx.

Medications.source_text: Taking 2-3 lemsips a day which eases sx.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with partner and dog.
Patient works as an office manager.

Review_of_Systems.content: No shortness of breath, inspiratory pain, or wheeze.
No history of chest problems, recurrent chest infections, or weight loss.
Review_of_Systems.source_text: No hx chest problems/recurrent chest infections/wt loss.

Review_of_Systems.content: No increased thirst or urinary frequency.
Patient does not check blood sugars or urine at home.
Review_of_Systems.source_text: Doesn't check blood sugars/urine at home.

Review_of_Systems.content: Patient thinks last blood pressure was fine but cannot remember when last BP or diabetes check-up was.
Review_of_Systems.source_text: Thinks last BP was fine, can't remember when last BP/DM check up was.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to continue Lemsips but avoid other paracetamol-containing products.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advised continue lemsips but no other paracetamol containing products.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to avoid cough syrup but may take it at night if unable to sleep.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Avoid cough syrup but can take if unable to sleep at night.

Plan_of_Care.content: Explained that illness may take 1–2 weeks to settle and that cough can persist for up to a month.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: May take 1-2 weeks to settle and cough can persist for up to a month

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to contact clinic if symptoms worsen, fever persists, or if coughing up phlegm, blood in sputum, or nose bleeds.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: but to contact us if symptoms not worse/fever persists - check with thermometer/coughing up phlegm/blood in sputum/nose bleeds.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient reminded to book regular diabetes and blood pressure check-up appointments.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Reminded to book regular diabetes and BP check-up appointments.
